title: Create my mobile game with Claude : Baguette Rush on iPhone and iPad
author: idashaf
selftext:

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/idashaf, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).

replies.author: idashaf
replies.body:
Hey, fair point, here’s how I actually built it.

Baget Run is a solo project, an endless runner for iPhone. I used Claude, Chatgpt mostly for **edit my code on Vscode**. For the art **i used blender**

My workflow was pretty simple: I’d describe one feature at a time get a first version from the AI, then test it on my phone and tweak it myself. I quickly learned that asking for the whole game at once gave messy code, so small focused requests worked way better.

Biggest problems I hit:  
**Bugs that i get to let the ai change my game**   
and   
Thing that the ai doesnt see like how to have more addiction in the game and more pleasure

Happy to answer questions about any part of it
